_readme: PiP-Disabler display-language file. Only the text on the right-hand side of ':' needs translating - never change the keys on the left, and never rename this file's 'sections'/'settings' keys. Step-by-step guide: i18n/README.md

Language.name: Language
Language.description:
Display language of this mod's settings.
Auto = follow the game's in-game language setting (recommended).
You can also type a language code directly, e.g. en, zh-CN, ru.
English = en, 中文 = zh-CN.
Language files live in BepInEx\plugins\PiP-Disabler\i18n\ - see i18n\README.md to add your own.

Mod Enabled.name: Mod Enabled
Mod Enabled.description: Master ON/OFF switch for the entire mod.

Mod Toggle Key.name: Mod Toggle Key
Mod Toggle Key.description: Toggle key for master mod enable/disable.

Auto Disable For NV/Thermals.name: Auto Disable For NV/Thermals
Auto Disable For NV/Thermals.description: Automatically disable the mod for thermal/night vision scopes.

Auto Bypass Name Contains.name: Auto Bypass Name Contains
Auto Bypass Name Contains.description: Semi-colon separated list. Any scope whose object name or scope key contains one of these gets bypassed

Scope Blacklist Names.name: Scope Blacklist Names
Scope Blacklist Names.description: Semi-colon separated list of scope keys that should bypass the mod.

Scope Blacklist Toggle Entry Key.name: Scope Blacklist Toggle Entry Key
Scope Blacklist Toggle Entry Key.description: When pressed while scoped, add/remove the current scope to the blacklist.

Scope Whitelist Names.name: Scope Whitelist Names
Scope Whitelist Names.description: Semi-colon separated list of allowed scopes. Empty list = whitelist ignored.

Scope Whitelist Toggle Entry Key.name: Scope Whitelist Toggle Entry Key
Scope Whitelist Toggle Entry Key.description: When pressed while scoped, add/remove the current scope to the whitelist.

FOV Fix Behaviour.name: FOV Fix Behaviour
FOV Fix Behaviour.description: If this is enabled, 1x FOV will be set to the game settings FOV

Global Scope Scaling Multiplier.name: Global Scope Scaling Multiplier
Global Scope Scaling Multiplier.description: Multiplies the scaling of all scopes, useful if you feel like the scopes are too small or too large.

Global Reticle Scaling Multiplier.name: Global Reticle Scaling Multiplier
Global Reticle Scaling Multiplier.description: Multiplies the scaling of all reticles, useful if you feel like the reticles are too small or too large.

Baseline FOV.name: Baseline FOV
Baseline FOV.description:
What to use when calculating magnified FOV (if set to 50 then 2x will be 25°).
\Be aware that 1x is always forced to 35° for stepped optics.

FOV Animation Duration.name: FOV Animation Duration
FOV Animation Duration.description: Duration of the FOV transitions during magnification changes.

Depth of field.name: Depth of field
Depth of field.description: Apply a masked dual Kawase blur outside the visible scope lens.

NVG Lens Blur.name: NVG Lens Blur
NVG Lens Blur.description: Blurs the image in the lens to mimic IRL NVG behaviour.

ADS Scope Alignment Angle Tolerance.name: ADS Scope Alignment Angle Tolerance
ADS Scope Alignment Angle Tolerance.description: Maximum angle in degrees between the active scope aim axis and the main camera before the mod activates after sprinting or stance transitions.

Post Sprint ADS Gate Duration.name: Post Sprint ADS Gate Duration
Post Sprint ADS Gate Duration.description: How long after sprinting the scope alignment gate should be enforced.

Bypass During Stance Transitions.name: Bypass During Stance Transitions
Bypass During Stance Transitions.description: Bypass the mod while changing between standing and prone.

Post Stance ADS Gate Duration.name: Post Stance ADS Gate Duration
Post Stance ADS Gate Duration.description: How long after standing/prone transitions the scope alignment gate should be enforced.

Reload Bypass Modifier.name: Reload Bypass Modifier
Reload Bypass Modifier.description: Changes the duration of the reload bypass, higher values lower the duration.

Scale Sway With Camera FOV.name: Scale Sway With Camera FOV
Scale Sway With Camera FOV.description: Lowers weapon sway while scoped in proportion to the current FOV.

Sway Modifier.name: Sway Modifier
Sway Modifier.description: Changes the intensity of the sway reduction.

Manual Weapon Scale.name: Manual Weapon Scale
Manual Weapon Scale.description: Direct ribcage compensation scale while scoped. Higher values make the weapon appear smaller.

Visual Recoil Compensation.name: Visual Recoil Compensation
Visual Recoil Compensation.description: Render-only screen-plane camera offset toward the optic camera for scope recoil/alignment at low FOV. Negative values invert direction. 0 = disabled.

Suppress Fire Mode Switch Movement.name: Suppress Fire Mode Switch Movement
Suppress Fire Mode Switch Movement.description: Prevents the weapon from playing the fire-mode switch movement animation while still changing fire mode.

Suppress Magnification Switch Movement.name: Suppress Magnification Switch Movement
Suppress Magnification Switch Movement.description: Prevents the weapon from playing the scope magnification switch movement animation while still changing magnification.

Force Recoil Return To Zero.name: Force Recoil Return To Zero
Force Recoil Return To Zero.description: Forces the weapon's post-recoil hand rotation rest point back to zero instead of using Tarkov's small randomized offset.

Keep scoped LOD Bias until inventory is.name: Keep scoped LOD Bias until inventory is opened
Keep scoped LOD Bias until inventory is.description:
When enabled, the scoped LOD bias stays active after leaving the scope and is only restored when opening inventory/loot or after a successful inventory item transfer.
\When disabled, LOD bias is restored immediately on scope exit.

Manual LOD Bias.name: Manual LOD Bias
Manual LOD Bias.description:
Manual LOD bias while scoped.
\0 = auto (Magnification * Auto LOD bias multiplier). 
\High values will impact performance !

Auto LOD bias multiplier.name: Auto LOD bias multiplier
Auto LOD bias multiplier.description:
Self explanatory 
\High values will impact performance !

Plane1Radius.name: Plane1Radius
Plane1Radius.description:
Near radius (meters) of the cylindrical/cone cut (camera side).
\Typical scope lens radius is ~0.01-0.02m.

Plane1OffsetMeters.name: Plane1OffsetMeters
Plane1OffsetMeters.description: Offset (meters) for plane 1 from linza/backLens origin along bore axis.

Plane2Position.name: Plane2Position
Plane2Position.description:
Plane 2 profile position (0..1) anchored from the near side.
\Changing CutLength keeps this plane at the same world-space depth from near.

Plane3Position.name: Plane3Position
Plane3Position.description: Normalized depth of plane 3 from near (0) to far (1).

Plane4Position.name: Plane4Position
Plane4Position.description: Normalized depth of plane 4 from near (0) to far (1). Usually 1.

CutStartOffset.name: CutStartOffset
CutStartOffset.description:
How far behind the backLens (toward the camera) the near cut plane starts.
\The near plane is fixed at: backLens - (offset × boreAxis).
\0 = starts exactly at the backLens. 0.05 = 5cm behind it (catches interior tube geometry).
\Changing CutLength does NOT move this plane.

CutLength.name: CutLength
CutLength.description:
How far forward from the near plane the cut extends (toward the objective).
\The far plane is at: nearPlane + (length × boreAxis).
\Only the far plane moves when you change this value.

NearPreserveDepth.name: NearPreserveDepth
NearPreserveDepth.description:
Depth (meters) from the near cut plane where NO geometry is cut.
\Preserves the eyepiece housing closest to the camera so you
\keep a thin ring framing the reticle while ADSing.
\0.01 = 1cm ring (default). 0.02-0.04 = thicker ring.
\0 = disabled (cut starts at the near plane — removes everything).

Mesh Reticle Min Scale.name: Mesh Reticle Min Scale
Mesh Reticle Min Scale.description: Minimum final mesh reticle scale after normalization and zoom. 0 = disabled.

Mesh Reticle Max Scale.name: Mesh Reticle Max Scale
Mesh Reticle Max Scale.description: Maximum final mesh reticle scale after normalization and zoom. 0 = disabled.

Mesh Reticle Normalized Scale.name: Mesh Reticle Normalized Scale
Mesh Reticle Normalized Scale.description: Multiplier applied after mesh reticle bounds normalization.

Mesh Reticle Minimum Stroke Enabled.name: Mesh Reticle Minimum Stroke Enabled
Mesh Reticle Minimum Stroke Enabled.description: Draws mesh reticles with a small screen-space dilation so thin details survive downscaling.

Mesh Reticle Minimum Stroke Pixels.name: Mesh Reticle Minimum Stroke Pixels
Mesh Reticle Minimum Stroke Pixels.description: Approximate minimum visible thickness for mesh reticles, in screen pixels.

ExpandSearchToWeaponRoot.name: ExpandSearchToWeaponRoot
ExpandSearchToWeaponRoot.description: Make the meshcutter run for the whole weapon.

Auto derive cut region from scope geomet.name: Auto derive cut region from scope geometry
Auto derive cut region from scope geomet.description:
Measure the optic's own renderer bounds around the cut axis and widen the cut
\radius envelope to match, instead of trusting the hand-tuned per-scope numbers
\(those were tuned against the 4.0.13 prefabs).
\The result is composed as max(derived, hand-tuned), so auto mode can only ever
\cut MORE than the hand-tuned profile, never less.
\Off = exactly the previous behaviour.

Auto derive margin.name: Auto derive margin
Auto derive margin.description: Multiplier applied to the derived radius: R = min(max(R_geo, R_manual) * margin + extra, max radius).

Auto derive extra radius meters.name: Auto derive extra radius meters
Auto derive extra radius meters.description: Constant added (meters) after the margin multiplier.

Auto derive max radius meters.name: Auto derive max radius meters
Auto derive max radius meters.description:
Upper clamp (meters) for every derived radius. The hand-tuned value is still
\enforced as a floor, so this clamp can never make the cut smaller than before.

Auto derive log derived profile.name: Auto derive log derived profile
Auto derive log derived profile.description:
Log the derived cut profile once per derivation (one line, no per-frame cost).
\Independent of 'Debug logging' so it can be enabled on its own.

DebugShowHousingMask.name: DebugShowHousingMask
DebugShowHousingMask.description: Render a red overlay wherever the lens stencil mask is.

DebugShowScopeShadowMask.name: DebugShowScopeShadowMask
DebugShowScopeShadowMask.description: Render the shadow lens mask as a green overlay for debugging.

Draw reticle after everything.name: Draw reticle after everything
Draw reticle after everything.description: Legacy setting. Reticles now always draw after everything and use the after-NVG reticle shader.

Save custom settings key.name: Save custom settings key
Save custom settings key.description: When pressed while scoped, saves all values from this category for the active scope key into custom_mesh_surgery_settings.json.

DeleteCustomMeshSurgerySettingsKey.name: DeleteCustomMeshSurgerySettingsKey
DeleteCustomMeshSurgerySettingsKey.description: When pressed while scoped, delete custom mesh surgery settings for the active scope key from custom_mesh_surgery_settings.json.

PlaneOffsetMeters.name: PlaneOffsetMeters
PlaneOffsetMeters.description: Custom per-scope plane offset applied along plane normal (meters).

Plane1Radius.name: Plane1Radius
Plane1Radius.description: Custom per-scope near radius in meters.

Plane1OffsetMeters.name: Plane1OffsetMeters
Plane1OffsetMeters.description: Custom per-scope plane 1 offset in meters.

Plane2Position.name: Plane2Position
Plane2Position.description: Custom per-scope plane 2 position (0..1), anchored from near when CutLength changes.

Plane2Radius.name: Plane2Radius
Plane2Radius.description: Custom per-scope plane 2 radius in meters.

Plane3Radius.name: Plane3Radius
Plane3Radius.description: Custom per-scope plane 3 radius in meters.

Plane4Radius.name: Plane4Radius
Plane4Radius.description: Custom per-scope plane 4 radius in meters.

CutStartOffset.name: CutStartOffset
CutStartOffset.description: Custom per-scope cut start offset in meters.

CutLength.name: CutLength
CutLength.description: Custom per-scope cut length in meters.

NearPreserveDepth.name: NearPreserveDepth
NearPreserveDepth.description: Custom per-scope near preserve depth in meters.

Reticle Size.name: Reticle Size
Reticle Size.description: Per-scope reticle size for scopes with a non scaling reticle. Needs to be saved to take effect.

Reticle Size Multiplier.name: Reticle Size Multiplier
Reticle Size Multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the per-scope reticle size. 1 = unchanged. Needs to be saved to take effect.

Variable Reticle Minimum Size.name: Variable Reticle Minimum Size
Variable Reticle Minimum Size.description: Custom per-scope smallest reticle size. If either max or min is set to 0 then this doesn't do anything. Needs to be saved to take effect.

Variable Reticle Maximum Size.name: Variable Reticle Maximum Size
Variable Reticle Maximum Size.description: Custom per-scope biggest reticle size. If either max or min is set to 0 then this doesn't do anything. Needs to be saved to take effect.

Weapon Scale Min Magnification.name: Weapon Scale Min Magnification
Weapon Scale Min Magnification.description: Custom per-scope ribcage scale at minimum magnification. 0 = use global Manual Weapon Scale. Needs to be saved to take effect. Higher values make the weapon appear smaller.

Weapon Scale Max Magnification.name: Weapon Scale Max Magnification
Weapon Scale Max Magnification.description: Custom per-scope ribcage scale at maximum magnification. 0 = use global Manual Weapon Scale. Needs to be saved to take effect. Higher values make the weapon appear smaller.

Weapon Scale Multiplier.name: Weapon Scale Multiplier
Weapon Scale Multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to both per-scope weapon scale limits. 1 = unchanged. Needs to be saved to take effect.

Visual Recoil Compensation.name: Visual Recoil Compensation
Visual Recoil Compensation.description: Custom per-scope visual recoil compensation. 0 = use global Visual Recoil Compensation. Needs to be saved to take effect. Negative values invert direction.

Vignette Opacity.name: Vignette Opacity
Vignette Opacity.description: Custom per-scope vignette opacity. 0 = use Scope Effects default.

Vignette Radius.name: Vignette Radius
Vignette Radius.description: Custom per-scope vignette radius. 0 = use Scope Effects default.

Vignette Softness.name: Vignette Softness
Vignette Softness.description: Custom per-scope vignette softness. 0 = use Scope Effects default.

ExpandSearchToWeaponRoot.name: ExpandSearchToWeaponRoot
ExpandSearchToWeaponRoot.description: Custom per-scope search root expansion to Weapon_root.

Vignette.name: Vignette
Vignette.description: Render a circular vignette ring around the scope aperture.

Vignette Opacity.name: Vignette Opacity
Vignette Opacity.description: Maximum opacity of the lens vignette ring (0=invisible, 1=full black).

Vignette Radius.name: Vignette Radius
Vignette Radius.description: Inner clear radius of the lens vignette (0=center starts darkening, 0.5=outer half darkened, 1=edge only).

Vignette Softness.name: Vignette Softness
Vignette Softness.description: Fraction of the vignette radius used for the gradient falloff (0=hard edge, 1=full gradient).

Scope Shadow.name: Scope Shadow
Scope Shadow.description: Overlay a fullscreen black shadow everywhere except the lens mask.

ScopeShadow Persist On Unscope.name: ScopeShadow Persist On Unscope
ScopeShadow Persist On Unscope.description: Keep the scope shadow visible after leaving ADS until the FOV restore finishes, useful when FOV animation set to 0.

ScopeShadow Opacity.name: ScopeShadow Opacity
ScopeShadow Opacity.description: Maximum opacity of the scope shadow overlay.

Depth of field Blur Downsample.name: Depth of field Blur Downsample
Depth of field Blur Downsample.description: Downsample divisor for outside-scope blur. Higher values are faster but softer/blockier.

Depth of field Blur Iterations.name: Depth of field Blur Iterations
Depth of field Blur Iterations.description: Dual Kawase chain depth outside the scope lens.

Depth of field Blur Radius.name: Depth of field Blur Radius
Depth of field Blur Radius.description: Dual Kawase sample offset in current-pass pixels.

Depth of field Blur Opacity.name: Depth of field Blur Opacity
Depth of field Blur Opacity.description: Blend strength of the blurred outside-scope image.

Depth of field Blur Darkening.name: Depth of field Blur Darkening
Depth of field Blur Darkening.description: Extra darkening applied to the blurred outside-scope image.

Depth of field Blur Radial Gate.name: Depth of field Blur Radial Gate
Depth of field Blur Radial Gate.description: Fade in outside-scope blur by screen distance from the lens center.

Depth of field Blur Radial Gate Start.name: Depth of field Blur Radial Gate Start
Depth of field Blur Radial Gate Start.description: Distance from lens center, in lens radii, where outside-scope blur starts.

Depth of field Blur Radial Gate Softness.name: Depth of field Blur Radial Gate Softness
Depth of field Blur Radial Gate Softness.description: Fade width for the radial blur gate, in lens radii.

NVG Lens Blur Multiplier.name: NVG Lens Blur Multiplier
NVG Lens Blur Multiplier.description: Multiplier for the NVG lens blur, higher means more blurrr.
